package postgres

import (
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"testing"
)

func TestLessonCommandProgressionRequiresCurrentEligibleItem(t *testing.T) {
	for _, target := range []domain.LearningPathItemStatus{domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, domain.LearningPathItemReady, domain.LearningPathItemInProgress} {
		items := []domain.LearningPathItem{{Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemCompleted}, {Position: 1, Status: domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered}, {Position: 2, Status: target}}
		if !lessonCommandProgressionAllowed(items, 2) {
			t.Fatalf("eligible next/current %s denied", target)
		}
		items[0].Status = domain.LearningPathItemReady
		if lessonCommandProgressionAllowed(items, 2) {
			t.Fatal("unfinished predecessor admitted")
		}
		items[0].Status = domain.LearningPathItemCompleted
		items = append(items, domain.LearningPathItem{Position: 3, Status: domain.LearningPathItemInProgress})
		if lessonCommandProgressionAllowed(items, 2) {
			t.Fatal("other active route item admitted")
		}
	}
	if lessonCommandProgressionAllowed([]domain.LearningPathItem{{Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemCompleted}}, 0) {
		t.Fatal("terminal command admitted")
	}
	if lessonCommandProgressionAllowed(nil, 0) {
		t.Fatal("missing target admitted")
	}
}
